preconditions.description: The number of queries q is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 50 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for n in [int(line.split()[0])])
preconditions.description: For each query, n is an integer between 1 and 50 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= s <= 200 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for s in [int(line.split()[1])])
preconditions.description: For each query, s is an integer between 0 and 200 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= 2000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for k in [int(line.split()[2])])
preconditions.description: For each query, k is an integer between 0 and 2000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one line per query.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_line.strip() == '-1') or (all(0 <= int(x) <= 200 for x in stdout_line.split()) and len(stdout_line.split()) == n) for stdout_line, n in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: For each query, the output line is either '-1' or a space-separated list of n non-negative integers (each ≤ 200).

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_line.strip() == '-1') or (sum(int(x) for x in stdout_line.split()) == s) for stdout_line, s in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', the sum of the array elements equals s.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_line.strip() == '-1') or (sum(abs(int(stdout_line.split()[i]) - int(stdout_line.split()[j])) for i in range(n) for j in range(i, n)) == k) for stdout_line, n, k in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]], [int(line.split()[2]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', the sum of absolute differences between each pair of elements equals k.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_line.strip() == '-1') or (all(int(stdout_line.split()[i]) <= int(stdout_line.split()[j]) for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n)) or any(int(stdout_line.split()[i]) < int(stdout_line.split()[j]) for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n) if all(int(stdout_line.split()[x]) == int(stdout_line.split()[y]) for x in range(i) for y in range(x)))) for stdout_line, n in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', the array is lexicographically smallest among all valid solutions.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_line.strip() == '-1') or (not any((sum(int(x) for x in stdout_line.split()) == s) and (sum(abs(int(stdout_line.split()[i]) - int(stdout_line.split()[j])) for i in range(n) for j in range(i, n)) == k) and (all(int(stdout_line.split()[i]) <= int(stdout_line.split()[j]) for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n)) or any(int(stdout_line.split()[i]) < int(stdout_line.split()[j]) for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n) if all(int(stdout_line.split()[x]) == int(stdout_line.split()[y]) for x in range(i) for y in range(x)))) for candidate in [line for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() != '-1'] if candidate != stdout_line)) for stdout_line, n, s, k in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]], [int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]], [int(line.split()[2]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', no other valid solution exists that is lexicographically smaller.
